automation_statements.quote: a SU523HD will be automatically created and issued

automation_statements.quote: If rent verification has not been provided within 28 days, ACS will automatically update to Not Verified - NVE.

automation_statements.what: A new Rent Certificate automatically issues when a line already coded RVR is updated
automation_statements.quote: verification code RVR is already on the line being updated. A new Rent Certificate will automatically issue with the updated information.

automation_statements.what: Recoding NVE to RVR issues a rent certificate
automation_statements.quote: Update the verification code from NVE to RVR. This will issue a rent certificate.

automation_statements.what: Gov Sub-tenant field automatically updates to not verified at day 28, stopping RA
automation_statements.quote: If there has been no update by day 28, the Government Sub-tenant field in Customer First or Gov Sub-tenant field in Process Direct will auto update. The Sub-tenant status will change to not verified which stops the RA

automation_statements.what: The system applies the two-thirds rule to board and lodgings amounts
automation_statements.quote: The system will automatically apply the two-thirds rule to the amount recorded in the Net Rent Amount field

automation_statements.quote: This system issue causes the system to apply a Notification Handler (NOHL) Rule 10 which pays an increased or new rate of RA from the entitlement period start date instead of the date of notification.

automation_statements.what: RA rates are calculated by the system and shown on the AR screen
automation_statements.quote: how to find more information about rates calculated by the system

automation_statements.quote: When coding in Process Direct the $ Gross Household Rent and $ Net Rent fields will default to 0.00 when left blank.

automation_statements.quote: When the activity is completed: a debt activity may be created and this will appear on the Activity List (AL) screen

automation_statements.what: The system assesses entitlement as if a debt was repaid and may pay it again after a later update
automation_statements.quote: If the system identifies a debt/possible debt: It assesses the customer's entitlement as if the customer has returned the money If a later update determines the customer was entitled to receive it, the system will attempt to pay it again

automation_statements.what: Manual reviews mature on the coded due date and Workload Management allocates them
automation_statements.quote: The review will mature on the Due Date coded in the RVR activity. Workload Management will allocate the review for manual action.

automation_statements.what: Capability-adjusted work items automatically unassign and reassign with the new skill tag
